clips.send: Buoyancy. The upward push of a liquid. A liquid pushes up on anything placed in it. This upward push is the buoyant force. The buoyant force equals the weight of the liquid the object pushes aside (displaces). An object less dense than the liquid floats; one that is denser sinks. A floating object sinks only deep enough to displace its own weight — the less dense it is, the higher it rides (look at the ping-pong ball).
